target: Grainger — GTG Intern Software Engineer (B2B industrial distribution)
phase: 4/4 - CI/CD + report (all must-have v1 complete, measured)
stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Postgres 16 (full-text tsvector/ts_rank + GIN), psycopg 3, rapidfuzz, PyJWT, token-bucket rate limiter, prometheus-client, structlog, pytest+coverage, ruff, GitHub Actions, Docker + docker-compose

measurement_methodology.relevance: ground truth by structured product attributes (subtype/material/attributes), independent of the ranking which only sees the free-text query; 16 labeled queries (10 with misspelled typo variants); precision@k, MRR, fuzzy recall@k. precision@10<1.0 is a denominator artifact for queries with <10 relevant SKUs (P@1 and MRR are 1.0).
measurement_methodology.search_engine: Postgres full-text (websearch_to_tsquery + ts_rank over a weighted GIN tsvector) blended with rapidfuzz per-token best-match; score = 0.7*norm(ts_rank) + 0.3*(fuzzy/100), fixed weights.
measurement_methodology.atp: ATP = on_hand - reserved per warehouse (never negative); 40 availability scenarios verified ATP == on_hand-reserved; reservation lifecycle reserve x2 + release x2 exact.
measurement_methodology.oversell: 3 concurrent races via ThreadPoolExecutor hitting reserve() which uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE row-locking; 95 total concurrent attempts; successes == floor(on_hand/qty), reserved never exceeds on_hand, DB CHECK(reserved<=on_hand) backstop; 0 oversell.
measurement_methodology.security: 5 controls exercised via TestClient: 401 (no token on /reserve), 403 (buyer on /admin), 422 (bad body/attr filter), 429 (token bucket), SQLi (injection in q + attr filter leaves products 839->839, parameterized psycopg).
measurement_methodology.latency: in-process FastAPI TestClient (ASGI), excludes network socket; 300 timed requests/endpoint, 30 warmup excluded, mixed query set.

unmeasured.network_latency: ___ (latency measured in-process via TestClient, not over a real HTTP/TCP socket; the compose gateway does serve over a socket but p50/p95 are the in-process numbers)

ci: committed .github/workflows/ci.yml (Postgres 16 service -> ruff -> seed -> pytest -> coverage>=80 gate); same 4 steps also run locally and pass (ruff clean, 49 passed, coverage 94% >= 80). GitHub Actions run status on the private repo not yet confirmed by orchestrator.
